name: Hylant Group Building (Libbey-Owens-Ford, 1960), 811 Madison Ave
refs: refs/w189369980/00 (Hylant Group Building in Downtown Toledo, Ohio, July 2019, Wikimedia Commons)
notes: 15 storeys of dark grey glass curtain wall in a fine mullion grid with a spandrel band at each floor, on a recessed glazed ground floor; mechanical rooftop. Built as the glass maker LOF's headquarters.
